name: training_modes
description: Stage 3: training context only (teacher forcing vs scheduled reconstructed context vs codec rollout). Base = the position-ablation winner (bit_plane_rowcol, train_size 1024 from data scaling; see results/position_ablation/DECISION.md); everything else fixed. teacher_forcing is config-identical to position_ablation/bit_plane_rowcol. The scheduled schedule uses fractions of the step budget (schedule_unit progress) so it is independent of dataset size.
